answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent makes one voyage of attested tasks, while a hollow claim with no countersignatures earns nothing, and a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake. A lagoon of pooled rewards then flows only to identities with a real, checkable history, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup.
